name: sheaim_warrior
description: a Sheaim Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a gaunt bald pale man with skull face paint (black eye sockets and a painted jaw), bare bony chest with a dark grey cloth sash across it, a purple ragged loincloth hung with bone ornaments and a bone skull belt buckle, dark grey leg wraps and black boots, a crude spiked wooden club with bone spikes raised in his RIGHT hand and a round wooden shield with a bone skull emblem, an iron rim and an orange strap on his LEFT arm
hands: the spiked club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the skull shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the spiked club is lifted beside the head with its bone-spiked head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the spiked club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round skull shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the spiked club is level, its head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the spiked club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round skull shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the spiked club carries on down until its head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the ragged purple loincloth flaring back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the spiked club comes back up on the near side toward the raised ready angle, the round skull shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; bald head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round skull shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the spiked club dipping, the round skull shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round skull shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, bald head droops, the spiked club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the head of the spiked club resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the spiked club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the spiked club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round skull shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round skull shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the spiked club and the round skull shield on the ground beside him
